FIVE OF NINE dev_storyflow entries had their headline ask ALREADY SHIPPED by the time anyone triaged them, INCLUDING THE MOST EXPENSIVE ONE. Triaged 2026-09-04 over lines 6726–7054 of the fleet's append-only feedback file — 329 lines, nine entries dated 2026-08-23 (evening) through 2026-09-02.

SHIPPED BEFORE TRIAGE, each verified against the current build rather than recalled:
① 🔴 'nothing joins a repair to the check that found it' — the entry that opened with a session reporting FIXED WORK AS BROKEN to its user. This is `invalidates`, and the tool's own description cites THIS INCIDENT verbatim as the measured cost of not having it.
② the duplicate guard matching across node types — chg:a-cross-type-near-match-is-named-as-a-layer (2026-08-29) and chg:the-prescribed-layer-pairs-stop-refusing (2026-09-01).
③ the snapshot warning firing on a four-minute-old node — chg:the-snapshot-warning-is-field-aware-and-the-export-note-reaches-the-caller.
④ `gaps_to_prompts` degrading silently on replay — chg:the-replayed-gap-is-an-echo.
⑤ `detect_gaps` overflowing with no paging — `budget_chars`, `scope` and `narrowing_note` all exist now.

⭐ THE PATTERN IS NOT THAT THE REPORTS ARE STALE — IT IS THAT THE LOOP IS ONE-WAY. Their reports are acted on; nothing tells them so. Each entry was written in good faith about a real defect, most were fixed within days, and the reporter had no way to learn it. This is the third independent instance of `fact:an-agent-that-cannot-name-its-version-reports-fixed-bugs`, and it is the strongest one yet because the flagship fix (`invalidates`) was BUILT FROM THIS REPORTER'S OWN EARLIER ENTRY and they still filed the same complaint again.

🛑 THE TRIAGE ANCHOR ALMOST FAILED, and the standing note is wrong about how to find it. The note says older uploads are STRICT PREFIXES, verified with `head -n <old> <new> | diff`. The previous excerpt (`docs/feedback/2026-08-23-...`) is 533 lines and is NOT a prefix — it is a curated extract with its own heading, so the diff proves nothing and the 533 would have been read as the anchor, re-triaging ~6,500 lines. THE USABLE ANCHOR IS THE LINE COUNT THE EXCERPT STATES ABOUT THE SOURCE IN ITS OWN HEADER (6,725), not the excerpt's own length.

NOT ESTABLISHED: whether the v0.47.0 triage (2026-09-02/03) already read the three 2026-09-02 entries. No artifact was registered for a dev_storyflow read after 2026-08-23, so the record cannot say; the six open findings were confirmed against the BUILD, which settles their currency regardless of who read what.
